title: Derived pullback is left adjoint to derived direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The derived pullback $Lf^*:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is left adjoint to the derived direct image $Rf_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]: $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(Lf^*G,F)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_Y)}(G,Rf_*F)$ bifunctorially in $F\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $G\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$, with derived categories as in [def-pc-derived-category].

proof.text: Use the tensor pullback/direct image adjunction and map it to homotopy categories. Extract the chosen derived pullback counit and universal property from exists_derivedPullback; Functor.ext applied to its object and map clauses identifies its underived functor with Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f.

Install the recorded sheaf tensor structure, functorial flat resolutions, and exact colimits. The existing K-flat machinery gives the localizer K-flat left derivability structure. Translate categorical K-flatness to the sheaf K-flat predicate using kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic and the homotopy quotient characterization, then apply the chosen counit clause to obtain the left derived composite property.

The module category on X is Grothendieck abelian and hence has K-injective resolutions. Apply the existing right-derived-functor composition theorem to the direct-image unit and derived pullback, obtaining the right derived composite property.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derived to the homotopy adjunction, the chosen pullback counit, the direct-image unit, and the two composite universal properties. Explicitly specify the derived functors so the result is exactly derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f, then package it as Nonempty.
